- The finite elements method can be used for numerical calculation of magnetic dissipation and electromagnetic forces.
the magnetic forces and magnetic dissipation are numerically calculated by the application of finite elements method.

the finite elements method enables determination of magnetic field in linear and non linear materials, and by application of this method the dissipation inductor and electromagnetic forces are determined.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the calculation of magnetic dissipation and electromagnetic forces in the power transformers.
the numerical calculation of the magnetic field in the transformer and calculation of electromagnetic forces and dissipation in the windings.
the calculation of magnetic dissipation and calculation of forces in the transformer windings by application of the finite element method.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
numerical calculation of magnetic dissipation and electromagnetic forces is a complex problem, which requires a lot of experience in the use of numerical methods.

the numerical methods of determining magnetic fields in power transformers, in comparison to the analytical and graphical ones, have the following advantages: - the ability to determine the field in nonlinear materials; - the ability to calculate the field in materials with non isotropic characteristics; - the possibility of determining the field in materials which have permanent magnetic stimulus; - the ability of determining the field for different positions of windings and core; - possibility to determine the magnetic field for different positions and geometries of windings; -
the finite elements analysis is a very useful tool for calculation of the magnetic fields and forces in the transformers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the finite elements method is very suitable for analysis of complex magnetic fields in the transformer.
the finite elements analysis is very effective method for calculation of magnetic field.
the application of the method of finite element in calculation of magnetic field and determination of electromagnetic forces and dissipation in the transformer windings is a good solution.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the numerical calculation of the magnetic field and the forces in the transformer can be performed by application of the finite element method.
the finite element method is very useful for the analysis of electromagnetic field in power transformers.

the numerical calculation of the magnetic field in transformer can give a good approximation of the distribution of the field, the dissipated energy in transformer core and electromagnetic forces on the windings.
